Description: Denali ECS/RDS auto-scheduler - Lambda functions + EventBridge rules

Properties.Description: Scales ECS to 0 and stops RDS denali-prod
Starts RDS denali-prod, polls until available, scales ECS to 1
Re-stops RDS if auto-restarted while ECS is scaled to 0

Properties.Name: denali-shutdown-nightly
Properties.Description: Every night 11:00pm CT (04:00 UTC, CDT pin — drifts to 10pm CST in winter)

Properties.Name: denali-startup-daily
Properties.Description: Every day 8:00am CT (13:00 UTC, CDT pin — drifts to 7am CST in winter)

Properties.Name: denali-safety-stop-cron
Properties.Description: Every 6 days re-stop RDS if ECS is 0 (handles 7-day auto-restart)
